title: Returned-Payment Addition to RentGuard Late Charges
content:
## Fee tariff — late charge addition for dishonoured payments (RentGuard Renters Policy)

Late charge addition for dishonoured payments: when two or more renters payments were returned unpaid in the last 12 calendar months, 2.00 USD is added to the base of the late charge; when exactly one was returned unpaid in the last 12 calendar months, 1.00 USD is added; when none was returned, nothing is added.

A payment returned unpaid is a payment the bank returned and the premium account reversed; each such return posted on the renters policy's premium account within the last 12 calendar months counts once.

| Renters payments returned unpaid, last 12 calendar months | Added to the base of the late charge |
|---|---|
| None | Nothing |
| Exactly one | 1.00 USD |
| Two or more | 2.00 USD |

Points of judgement:

- Only returns on this RentGuard renters policy's premium account are counted.
- A return posted more than 12 calendar months ago no longer counts; one posted within the period does.
- The addition is the same 2.00 USD whether two, three or more payments were returned.

*Hypothetical illustration:* one returned payment 3 months ago and another 13 months ago — only the first falls in the period, so 1.00 USD is added.
